# Start here: Build your first agentic workflow

Welcome to the **Agentic Workflows workshop**. You will compile and run a prebuilt workflow, learn how safe outputs protect GitHub writes, create another workflow, and automate test review on pull requests.

Open `README.md` at the repository root and use it as the complete workshop guide:

1. Verify the Codespace and PR-required ruleset.
2. Compile, merge, and manually run the prebuilt Test Quality Checker.
3. Complete and merge one starter workflow or a small workflow of your own.
4. Merge the Test Quality Checker PR trigger.
5. Open a separate test-change PR and watch the workflow post its review comment.

You are finished when the test-change pull request automatically runs the Test Quality Checker and contains its comment or an explicit no-op result.
